titleTh: ซื้อครีมทาผิวไหม้แดด
scenarioSentences: You went to the beach yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello. I have a bad sunburn on my arms.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Young
dialogue.text: Oh dear. Did you go to the beach?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, yesterday. I didn't wear any sunscreen.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Young
dialogue.text: This cream is good for sunburn. Use it three times a day.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. I'm on vacation. Can I go to the beach today?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Young
dialogue.text: Yes, but wear a big hat. We sell sun hats here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll take the cream and a hat, please.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Young
dialogue.text: Sure. That's nineteen dollars, please.

titleTh: เรียนกีตาร์ครั้งแรก

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Mr. Dupont, my fingers hurt. Is that normal?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Dupont
dialogue.text: Yes, it's normal at the start. It stops after two weeks.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. How often do I need to practice?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Dupont
dialogue.text: Every day, but only for twenty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Only twenty minutes? That's not much.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Dupont
dialogue.text: A little practice every day really helps your fingers.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What can I play at home?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Dupont
dialogue.text: Play the easy song from today's lesson.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll practice for twenty minutes every day.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Dupont
dialogue.text: Great. See you next Tuesday for your second lesson.

titleEn: Ordering a drink at a juice bar
titleTh: สั่งน้ำผลไม้ที่ร้านน้ำปั่น
scenarioSentences: You go to a juice bar.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. What fruit juices do you have today?

dialogue.speaker: Tina
dialogue.text: We have orange, pineapple and mango.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Mango sounds good. Does it have sugar in it?

dialogue.speaker: Tina
dialogue.text: Usually a little, but I can make it with no sugar.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No sugar, please. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Tina
dialogue.text: A small is three dollars, and a large is five.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A small one, please. Can I have ice too?

dialogue.speaker: Tina
dialogue.text: Sure. One small mango juice, no sugar, with ice.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. Here's three dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Tina
dialogue.text: Thank you. It will be ready in two minutes.

titleEn: Getting a map at the tourist office
titleTh: ขอแผนที่ที่ศูนย์ข้อมูลนักท่องเที่ยว
scenarioSentences: You are visiting a new city.
You go to the tourist office.
Mr. Moss works at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello. I'm only here for one day. What can I see?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Moss
dialogue.text: The old town is lovely, and it's near here.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Do you have a map?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Moss
dialogue.text: Yes, here's a free map. The old town walk is in red.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long is the walk?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Moss
dialogue.text: About two hours. It starts at the old church.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Are there any good places to eat?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Moss
dialogue.text: Yes, the market square has lots of small restaurants.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'll do the walk this morning and eat there.

titleTh: ไปงานบาร์บีคิวที่บ้านเพื่อน
scenarioSentences: Your friend Eric is having a barbecue.
You want to bring some food.
You do not know the way.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Eric. Thanks for the invitation! What can I bring on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.text: We have lots of meat. Can you bring a salad?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll make a big salad.

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.text: Great. And it starts at three.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How do I get to your place? I don't have a car.

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.text: Take bus 5 from the station. Get off at Park Road.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How long is the ride?

dialogue.speaker: Eric
dialogue.text: About fifteen minutes. My house is next to the stop.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect. See you at three, then.

titleTh: ซื้อดอกไม้ขอบคุณคุณครู
scenarioSentences: You want to give her flowers.
You go to a flower shop.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello. I'd like some flowers for my teacher, to say thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Flores
dialogue.text: How nice! How much do you want to spend?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Not much. About fifteen dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Flores
dialogue.text: Then a small bunch is good. What colors does she like?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: She often wears yellow.

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Flores
dialogue.text: These yellow ones are fresh today. A small bunch is fourteen dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: They're beautiful. I'll take them.

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Flores
dialogue.text: Would you like a card with them?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, please. I'll write a thank-you message.

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Flores
dialogue.text: Here's a pen. I'll get the flowers ready.

titleTh: เช็กอินเข้าพักที่โฮสเทล
scenarioSentences: You have a bed for two nights.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. I'd like to check in. I have a bed for two nights.

dialogue.speaker: Pia
dialogue.text: Welcome! Your passport, please.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Here you are. Where is my bed?

dialogue.speaker: Pia
dialogue.text: Room 3, bed 4. It's up the stairs.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. Is there breakfast in the morning?

dialogue.speaker: Pia
dialogue.text: Yes, it's free. It starts at seven in the kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. Do I need a key for the room?

dialogue.speaker: Pia
dialogue.text: Yes. Here's your key card. Please give it back when you leave.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thanks. I'll come down for breakfast at seven.

titleEn: Washing clothes in the laundry room
titleTh: ซักผ้าที่ห้องซักรีดในหอพัก
scenarioSentences: You live in a student dorm.
You go to the laundry room.
You do not understand the machine.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Ahmed. How does this machine work?

dialogue.speaker: Ahmed
dialogue.text: It's easy. First, open the door and put your clothes in.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Where do I put the soap?

dialogue.speaker: Ahmed
dialogue.text: In this small box at the top. Just one cup.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: And then I press the green button?

dialogue.speaker: Ahmed
dialogue.text: Not yet. You need coins first. It's two dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Oh, I only have a five-dollar bill.

dialogue.speaker: Ahmed
dialogue.text: There's a coin machine by the door. It takes bills.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. I'll get coins now. Thanks!

dialogue.speaker: Ahmed
dialogue.text: No problem. The wash takes about forty minutes.

titleTh: ซื้อโคมไฟตั้งโต๊ะใหม่
scenarioSentences: You go to a home store.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. I'm looking for a desk lamp.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Stone
dialogue.text: Sure. Do you want a big one or a small one?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A small one, please. My desk is small.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Stone
dialogue.text: Then look at these two. The black one is only eighteen dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is it bright? I study at night.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Stone
dialogue.text: Not very. The white one is very bright, but it's twenty-two dollars.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I need good light for studying. I'll take the white one.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Stone
dialogue.text: Good choice. You can pay at the front, near the door.

titleEn: Visiting the zoo with a friend
titleTh: ชวนเพื่อนไปเที่ยวสวนสัตว์
scenarioSentences: You want to go to the zoo.
Your friend Rita wants to come.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Rita, let's go to the zoo this weekend. Are you free?

dialogue.speaker: Rita
dialogue.text: Only on Saturday. I have to work on Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Saturday morning or afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: Rita
dialogue.text: Morning. It's very hot in the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Right. Which animals do you want to see?

dialogue.speaker: Rita
dialogue.text: The elephants! There's a new baby elephant.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Oh, cute! Let's see the elephants first, then.

dialogue.speaker: Rita
dialogue.text: Yes. And then the monkeys.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: The zoo opens at nine. Let's meet at the gate.

dialogue.speaker: Rita
dialogue.text: Perfect. See you on Saturday!
